'''Senate Hill''', located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], was formed by a series of small, unimposing monuments to the justice and glory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] rebuilt much of Imperial City, he left Senate Hill alone, preferring to dwarf its significance with the massive size of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]].
